articleBody:
A plumbing issue on the weekend can throw a wrench in your plans, but being prepared for a plumber's visit can make the process much smoother and faster. Knowing what to do and what information to have ready can help our technicians at CG Plumbing Solutions diagnose and resolve your problem efficiently. This checklist will guide you through the essentials.

How to use this checklist

Use this checklist to quickly gather important information and take initial steps before our weekend plumber arrives. Each item helps ensure we can get right to work, understand your issue fully, and provide the best solution with minimal delay.

- [ ] **Locate your main water shutoff valve** — knowing where this is and how to turn it off is critical for preventing further water damage, especially with burst pipes or significant leaks.
- [ ] **Clear the area around the plumbing issue** — providing easy access to the problem spot means our plumber can quickly get to work without needing to move furniture or belongings.
- [ ] **Note down all symptoms and when they started** — a detailed timeline helps diagnose the root cause more accurately, whether it's a sudden burst or a gradual clog.
- [ ] **Check for fixture-level shutoff valves (under sinks, behind toilets)** — if the problem is confined to one fixture, shutting off its individual valve can stop water flow without affecting the rest of your home.
- [ ] **Stop using all indoor plumbing if you suspect a sewer backup** — continuing to use water will only make a sewage backup worse and spread contamination.
- [ ] **Document the damage with photos or videos** — visual evidence can be incredibly helpful for diagnosis and for any potential insurance claims you might need to make later.
- [ ] **Have payment information or questions about pricing ready** — understanding the diagnostic fee and weekend rates beforehand prevents surprises and allows for quick authorization of work.
- [ ] **Confirm whether the problem involves gas lines** — if you smell gas or suspect a gas leak, evacuate immediately and call your gas utility first, then inform us.
- [ ] **Provide any details about recent repairs or installations** — knowing about previous work can offer clues to the current problem and prevent unnecessary investigation.

What to Do Next

Once you’ve gone through this checklist, you’ll be well-prepared for your plumber’s arrival. If you're ready to schedule a weekend service or need immediate emergency plumbing help in the Las Vegas Valley, call CG Plumbing Solutions at (702) 843-0899. We're available when you need us.
